q1.question: How many quotes will I receive?
q1.answer: Typically 3–8 quotes depending on lane and shipment details. Popular lanes tend to have more forwarder coverage.

q2.question: Are forwarders really verified?
q2.answer: Yes. We vet business information, service capability, and track performance signals. Forwarders must pass our compliance checks.

q3.question: Is it free for shippers/exporters?
q3.answer: Submitting an RFQ is completely free. Forwarders access leads through subscription-based plans.

q4.question: Can I request DDP/DDU or customs support?
q4.answer: Yes—add it in your RFQ notes and we'll route to capable providers who offer those services.

q5.question: What modes do you support?
q5.answer: Sea, air, road, rail, and special cargo options depending on lane. Most major trade lanes are well covered.
